pages.text: Beatable alone in iron armour with a dog. These are the dark age's fallout, not its masters. They wander near home and you will meet them whether you look or not.$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Mutant Zombie$() and the $(bold)Mutant Enderman$() hold $(bold)Brass$().$(li)$(bold)Mutant Skeleton$() holds $(bold)Recruiting$().$(li)$(bold)Mutant Creeper$() holds $(bold)Blasting$().

$(bold)Fires, furnaces, insulation and waterskins$() are never locked: the hearth (Climate control) is Tier 2, and so is Slice & Dice (Advanced cooking), because Torte keeps it in the Nether.$(br2)The $(bold)Mutant Snow Golem$() is a pet you make, not a boss: it holds nothing.

Brass is the hinge of the whole tree: mechanical crafters, deployers, arms, trains, the smart funnels and filters that make a factory think. Zinc plus copper in a mixer over a blaze burner. The dead took the knowledge; the Mutant Zombie carries it.
pages.title: Why brass

pages.text: $(bold)Blasting$() covers TNT, gunpowder recipes, the blaze burner and musket cartridges. $(bold)Recruiting$() is hiring from Village Recruits; guards stay free.$(br2)A fresh server should clear Tier 1 in its first week.
